COPIED FROM research/estimated-payments/in.md, NOT FROM A PRIMARY SOURCE.

The Indiana Code could not be fetched for this package: on 2026-10-20
https://iga.in.gov/ic/2025/Title_6.html returned a 691-byte script shell to
curl, with no statute text. The quotes below are the research file's, which
its verification section (2026-10-20) records as read from the 2025 Indiana
Code, Title 6, and marks VERIFIED. They are copied here so that the tests can
check the statute side of each rule against something checked in. See
SOURCES.md.

[IC-4.1] IC 6-3-4-4.1, version effective 1-1-2026, 2025 Indiana Code.
[IC-2.1] IC 6-8.1-10-2.1, 2025 Indiana Code.

Item 1, [IC-4.1](b):
"no such declaration shall be required if the estimated tax can reasonably be expected to be less than one thousand dollars ($1,000)."

Item 1, [IC-4.1](b), from January 1, 2026:
"or for which tax is not remitted on behalf of the individual under IC 6-3-2.1"

Item 2, [IC-4.1](a)(3), effective 1-1-2026:
"Section 6654 ... shall be applied as if the tax liability for the preceding taxable year ... was zero dollars ($0)."

Item 2, the research's summary of [IC-4.1](a)(3):
"treats prior-year tax as $0 for someone who filed no prior-year return and can show no prior-year liability."

Verification, 2026 changes:
"P.L.205-2025, SEC.10, effective 1-1-2026: the [IC-4.1](a)(3) zero prior-year rule"

Verification, conflicts resolved, [IC-4.1](a):
"at the time or times and in the installments as provided by Section 6654"

Item 7, [IC-4.1](b):
"there shall be added to the tax a penalty in an amount prescribed by IC 6-8.1-10-2.1 (b)."

Item 7, [IC-2.1](b):
"the penalty described in subsection (a) is ten percent (10%) of"

Verification, conflicts resolved, [IC-2.1](d):
"failure to file a return, pay the full amount of tax shown ... or pay the deficiency"
